# TradeMemory — The Memory Layer for AI Trading Agents | Mnemox

Source: https://mnemox.ai/tradememory

Loading...

Loading...

It makes the same mistakes every session. It can't explain why it traded. It forgets everything when the context window ends. TradeMemory is the memory layer — one pip install, and your AI agent remembers every trade, every outcome, every mistake.

Your agent forgets every trade when the context window ends. It can't learn from past mistakes or remember what worked.

MiFID II and the EU AI Act require decision documentation. Your agent can't explain why it made each trade.

Every MCP server handles execution — placing orders, fetching prices. None handle memory. The AI trading stack is missing a layer.

Three steps. Before, during, and after every trade.

Before trading, recall past trades in similar market conditions. The system returns what happened last time and how it ended.

After trading, one call records everything. Five memory layers — episodic, semantic, procedural, affective, and audit — update automatically.

Daily and weekly reviews detect behavioral drift, strategy decay, and trading mistakes. The system tells you when to stop.

Pre-flight checklist before every trade. Memory is the starting point of the decision process, not an afterthought.

Automated sync from MT5. Records why signals were blocked, not just executed. Thousands of decisions daily.

SHA-256 tamper-proof audit trail. Every AI decision recorded and exportable for regulatory review.

# Mnemox AI — AI Tools for Traders &amp; Developers

Source: https://mnemox.ai/validate

Loading...

Loading...

Upload your trade log. 4 statistical tests. Verdict in 10 seconds.

Free: 3/month · Pro: unlimited ($29/mo)Drop your CSV file here, or click to browse

Supports daily returns CSV or QuantConnect trade logs

Your data stays in your browser. Nothing is stored.

Most backtested strategies fail in live trading because they are overfit to historical data. Strategy Validation applies rigorous statistical tests to determine if your edge is real or just noise. We test for multiple-testing bias, out-of-sample stability, regime robustness, and cross-validation consistency.

Adjusts your Sharpe ratio for the number of strategies you tested. If you tried 100 variants, a Sharpe of 1.5 might just be luck.

Splits your data into rolling windows of in-sample and out-of-sample periods. Tests if the strategy generalizes beyond the data it was trained on.

Evaluates performance across different market conditions — low/medium/high volatility and trending/ranging regimes. A real edge works in multiple regimes.

Combinatorial Purged Cross-Validation tests every possible train/test split. The gold standard for detecting overfitting in trading strategies.

# Privacy Policy — Mnemox AI | Mnemox

Source: https://mnemox.ai/privacy

# Privacy Policy

Last updated: March 30, 2026

## 1. Who We Are

Mnemox AI is a Taipei-based studio that builds AI trading infrastructure. This policy covers **www.mnemox.ai** and all associated services.

## 2. What We Collect

- **Account data**— When you sign in via Clerk (Google OAuth), we store your name, email, and profile image to manage your account.
- **Service inquiries**— When you submit a booking form on the Services page, we store your name, email, platform preference, service tier, and description. Your IP address is hashed for rate limiting only.
- **Idea checks**— Idea Reality Check queries are logged anonymously (no account linkage). We store the idea text, score, and country for aggregate analytics.
- **Usage data**— Standard web analytics (Vercel Analytics, Google Analytics) collect page views, referrers, and device type. No personal data is shared with third parties.

## 3. How We Use Your Data

- To provide and maintain our services
- To respond to service inquiries
- To generate aggregate analytics (Idea Pulse trends)
- To improve our products and user experience

## 4. Data Sharing

We do not sell your data. We share data only with:

- **Clerk**— Authentication provider
- **Supabase**— Database hosting (US infrastructure)
- **Vercel**— Website hosting and analytics
- **Google Analytics**— Anonymized web analytics

## 5. Data Retention

Account data is retained while your account is active. Service inquiries are retained for 12 months. Idea check logs are retained indefinitely in anonymized form. You can request deletion by emailing [dev@mnemox.ai](mailto:dev@mnemox.ai).

## 6. Cookies

We use essential cookies for authentication (Clerk session) and analytics (Google Analytics, Vercel). We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

## 7. Your Rights

You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting [dev@mnemox.ai](mailto:dev@mnemox.ai).

## 8. Contact

For privacy concerns, contact us at [dev@mnemox.ai](mailto:dev@mnemox.ai).

# Strategy Validator — Statistical Strategy Validation Pipeline | Mnemox AI | Mnemox

Source: https://mnemox.ai/portfolio/strategy-validator

Loading...

Loading...

Stop guessing. Start validating.

A professional-grade strategy validation pipeline that separates real trading edge from overfitting. Four-layer statistical testing — Deflated Sharpe Ratio, Walk-Forward, Regime Analysis, and 45-fold CPCV — built for traders who need statistical rigor before going live.

Most algorithmic traders run hundreds of backtests, pick the best-looking equity curve, and go live. But without correcting for multiple testing bias, out-of-sample validation, and regime robustness, that beautiful backtest is likely overfitted. The result: real capital lost on strategies that only worked in hindsight.

# MCP Servers for Finance and Trading: A Complete List (2026) | Mnemox Blog

Source: https://mnemox.ai/blog/mcp-servers-finance

# MCP Servers for Finance and Trading: A Complete List (2026)

The Model Context Protocol (MCP) lets AI agents call external tools through a standardized interface. For traders and fintech developers, this means your Claude, Cursor, or custom agent can fetch market data, execute trades, and manage risk — without writing custom API wrappers for every broker.

This list covers every MCP server built for finance, trading, and DeFi as of March 2026. We categorize them by use case so you can find the right one for your stack.

## What is an MCP server for trading?

An MCP server exposes tools that an AI agent can call. For trading, these tools typically fall into four categories: **market data** (prices, OHLCV, fundamentals), **trade execution** (place/cancel orders), **memory and analytics** (store trades, discover patterns), and **risk management** (position sizing, circuit breakers).

You install them via `pip install` or `npx`, add them to your MCP client config, and your agent gains access to the tools.

## Complete list

Persistent memory layer for AI trading agents. Three-layer architecture (raw trades → pattern discovery → strategy adjustment) with 17 MCP tools, Outcome-Weighted Memory, and an Evolution Engine that discovers strategies from raw price data.

Platforms: MT5, Binance, Alpaca, any platform · [GitHub](https://github.com/mnemox-ai/tradememory-protocol)

Real-time crypto market data and trading via 20+ exchanges using the CCXT library. Supports spot, futures, OHLCV, balances, and order management.

Platforms: Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, 20+ exchanges · [GitHub](https://github.com/doggybee/mcp-server-ccxt)

Yahoo Finance integration for stock market data including options recommendations.

Platforms: US stocks · [GitHub](https://github.com/ferdousbhai/investor-agent)

AI-powered trading bot platform. Create automated trading strategies with natural language via Alpaca brokerage.

Platforms: Alpaca · [GitHub](https://github.com/etbars/vibetrader-mcp)

Tastyworks API integration to handle trading activities on Tastytrade.

Platforms: Tastytrade · [GitHub](https://github.com/ferdousbhai/tasty-agent)

End-of-day and intraday stock market data, financial statements, insider trading data, sustainability data, and earnings releases.

Platforms: US, global equities · [GitHub](https://github.com/financialdatanet/mcp-server)

Fetch real-time stock prices from Stooq without API keys. Supports US, Japan, UK, and Germany markets.

Platforms: US, JP, UK, DE equities · [GitHub](https://github.com/hoqqun/stooq-mcp)

Multi-DEX perpetual futures trading. 18 tools for market data, trade execution with dry-run safety, funding rate arbitrage scanning, and portfolio analytics.

Platforms: Pacifica (Solana), Hyperliquid, Lighter (ETH) · [GitHub](https://github.com/hypurrquant/perp-cli)

Per-transaction deterministic crypto validator. Validate trades (PROCEED/CAUTION/BLOCK), scan tokens, detect rug pulls.

Platforms: Crypto · [GitHub](https://github.com/gpartin/CryptoGuardClient)

Access and analysis capabilities for Chinese stock market data via baostock.

Platforms: China A-shares · [GitHub](https://github.com/HuggingAGI/mcp-baostock-server)

Historical data from US, UK, Russian and Turkish stock exchanges. Sectors, tickers, company profiles, market cap, volume, treemap and histogram visualizations.

Platforms: US, UK, RU, TR equities · [GitHub](https://github.com/finmap-org/mcp-server)

## How to choose

- **Need market data only?**Use CCXT (crypto), FinancialData.Net (equities), or Stooq (global, no API key).
- **Need to execute trades?**VibeTrader (Alpaca), Tasty Agent (Tastytrade), or Perp CLI (DeFi perps).
- **Need your agent to remember and learn from trades?**- [TradeMemory Protocol](https://mnemox.ai/tradememory)— the only MCP server with persistent trade memory, pattern discovery, and strategy evolution.
- **Need risk checks before execution?**CryptoGuard for crypto token validation.

## Missing from this list?

New MCP servers ship every week. If you know one we missed, [open an issue](https://github.com/mnemox-ai/mnemox-web/issues/new) and we will add it.

# How to Check If Your Startup Idea Already Exists (Before You Build) | Mnemox Blog

Source: https://mnemox.ai/blog/check-startup-idea

# How to Check If Your Startup Idea Already Exists (Before You Build)

You have an idea for a developer tool. Before you spend weeks building it, you should check if someone already built it. This sounds obvious, but most developers skip this step — especially when using AI coding agents that start generating code immediately.

Y Combinator co-founder Paul Graham has a famous essay on the topic: founders often build solutions looking for problems. The fix is simple — search first, build second. Here are five methods, from manual to fully automated.

## Five methods compared

### GitHub Search

Low effort5–15 minCoverage: Open source only

### Product Hunt Browse

Medium effort10–20 minCoverage: Launched products

### App Store / Play Store

Low effort5–10 minCoverage: Mobile apps

### Ask ChatGPT / Claude

Low effort1 minCoverage: General knowledge

### idea-reality-mcp (automated)

None (agent runs it) effort3–15 secCoverage: GitHub + HN + npm + PyPI + Product Hunt + Stack Overflow

## The real problem: your AI agent never searches

Manual searches work — if you remember to do them. The problem is that AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot Workspace) start building the moment you describe your idea. They never pause to check if the idea already exists.

This is exactly what [idea-reality-mcp](https://mnemox.ai/check) solves. It is an MCP server — a tool your agent can call. Add one line to your agent config, and every new project starts with an automatic reality check:

Add to your CLAUDE.md or .cursorrules:

`When starting a new project, use the idea_check MCP tool to check if similar projects already exist.`## What a good result looks like

You: "AI code review tool"

idea_check →

├── reality_signal: 92/100

├── trend: accelerating ↗

├── GitHub repos: 847

├── Top competitor: reviewdog (9,094 ⭐)

├── npm packages: 56

└── Verdict: HIGH — find a niche fast

A score of 92 does not mean "do not build." It means the space is crowded — you need a specific angle. The pivot suggestions help you find that angle.

## Try it now

[Try idea-reality-mcp in your browser](https://mnemox.ai/check) — free, no signup. Or install locally:

`pip install idea-reality-mcp`Built by [Mnemox AI](https://mnemox.ai/). We build open-source MCP servers for trading memory and idea validation.
